mapper.sql: select id, trace_id, user_id, dept_id, question, context_type, context_id, space_ids_json, document_ids_json, status, model_name, latency_ms, error_message, created_time from kb_query_audit
mapper.insert: insert into kb_query_audit ( trace_id, user_id, dept_id, question, context_type, context_id, space_ids_json, document_ids_json, status, model_name, latency_ms, error_message, created_time ) values ( #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{question}, #{contextType}, #{contextId}, #{spaceIdsJson}, #{documentIdsJson}, #{status}, #{modelName}, #{latencyMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: select id, trace_id, user_id, dept_id, question, context_type, context_id, space_ids_json, document_ids_json, status, model_name, latency_ms, error_message, created_time from kb_query_audit where trace_id = #{traceId} limit 1
select question, count(1) as total from kb_query_audit where created_time >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval 7 day) group by question order by total desc limit #{limit}

select id, trace_id, user_id, dept_id, question, context_type, context_id, space_ids_json, document_ids_json, status, model_name, latency_ms, error_message, created_time from kb_query_audit where status <> 'SUCCESS' order by id desc limit #{limit}
